name: Hearth · Home
description: A single-file H5 smart-home control app in a dark theme: 14 screens, 6 rooms, 19 devices of 7 kinds, 5 scenes, 4 automations, a security panel and a weekly energy view. Continuous controls (brightness, volume, blind position, thermostat set-point), a segmented alarm control and a time picker are the new interaction primitives. The floor plan is state-driven — its rooms glow from the live device state — so the picture is an observation, not decoration.

finish.answer: final answer for question tasks; optional for action tasks

observation.text: engine.a11y(state) — an accessibility tree with #test-ids. The floor plan, sliders, segmented controls and charts all serialise to text, so a text-only agent sees the same facts a viewer does.
observation.pixels: 390x844 screenshot (browser backend); __ENV__.bounds() maps every test-id to a pixel box
observation.state: engine.snapshot(state) — canonical state plus a derived view. For the verifier only; never feed it to the agent.

world.power: live draw = sum over devices; a light draws watts x brightness/100, everything else draws its rating when on. 519 W at reset.
world.energy: the weekly chart and per-room kWh are fixed mock history, not derived from the live state
world.units: Celsius by default; Settings switches the display to Fahrenheit (state always stores Celsius)
